description: This is a PHP unit test file for the EmployeeEducationDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It contains test cases for CRUD operations and search functionality on EmployeeEducation entities, using a test fixture for initial data setup.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeEducationDao, containing test methods for CRUD and search operations on employee education data within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for each test, creating an instance of EmployeeEducationDao and populating test data from a fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an EmployeeEducation record by ID and verifies its fields.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests deletion of specified EmployeeEducation records and verifies deletion count.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests search functionality for EmployeeEducation records filtered by employee number, expecting multiple results.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEducationWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search functionality with a limit parameter, expecting a single result.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests saving (creating) a new EmployeeEducation record and verifies the saved data.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests editing an existing EmployeeEducation record and verifies the updated data.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEducationsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of EmployeeEducation records matching search criteria.
